content: प्रणयनम् .²1 Bringing, fetching. .²2 Conducting, conveying. .²3 Carrying out, executing, performing; सर्गशेषप्रणयनाद्विश्वयोनेरनन्तरम् <ls>Ku. 6. 9</ls>. .²4 Writing, composing. .²5 Decreeing, sentencing, awarding; as दण्डस्य प्रणयनम्. .²6 Bringing forward, adducing. .²7 Distributing. .²8 Infliction of (punishment). .²9 Founding (of a school).
